name: Catalog Footage
description: Catalogs the raw footage files into a structured clip catalog.

inputs.name: project_config
inputs.description: State input: project_config - the project's own declarations. `audio.program_stream` (or `source.program_stream`) declares which audio stream is the program mix. Without a declaration, the catalog can select a unique default mono/stereo AAC/PCM stream beside spatial-only tracks; `audio.measure_program_stream` (or `source.measure_program_stream`) opts into measurement for other multi-stream layouts.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: State input: project_folder - read for the project's own `source:` block in project.yaml when the broadcast project_config carries no program-stream declaration.

inputs.name: program_stream
inputs.description: Direct input: the 1-based program-mix channel ordinal, overriding any declaration. Absent in ordinary runs.

inputs.name: measure_program_stream
inputs.description: Direct input: measure the program mix off the footage, overriding any declaration. Absent in ordinary runs.

inputs.name: raw_audio_files
inputs.description: State input: raw_audio_files - scan's audio-only files in audio_001 numbering. Absent on runs whose scan predates it; empty on video-only projects.

inputs.name: model_revision
inputs.description: State input: model_revision - the scan's Project Model revision, routed over the DAG edge. Stamped onto every clip_catalog entry and the catalog output so a reader knows which revision's assets/streams/clocks its rows resolve into. Absent on runs whose scan predates Lane B; None when the scan's link was refused.

outputs.name: project_fps
outputs.description: Modal frame rate of the source footage - the pipeline's timebase. Read from the container's own rational, unrounded.

outputs.name: project_frame_rate_rational
outputs.description: State output: project_frame_rate_rational - the project's frame rate as the container's own rational ({numerator, denominator}). The float beside it is that rational read; this is the measurement. Absent when no clip carried a measurable rate.

outputs.name: project_frame_rate_assumption
outputs.description: State output: project_frame_rate_assumption - the NAMED assumption, when no clip in the catalog carried a measurable frame rate and the project rate is the engine's standing assumption of 30 fps. Names the site, the value and the reason. Absent when a rate was measured.

outputs.name: source_resolution
outputs.description: Modal SOURCE resolution. Describes the footage; NOT the render target. The delivery format comes from library/tools/delivery_format.py.

outputs.name: audio_catalog
outputs.description: State output: audio_catalog - voiceover and music files in audio_001 numbering with duration, audio streams and the program-stream decision. No picture keys by contract. Empty on video-only projects, which is the normal case.

outputs.name: duplicate_groups
outputs.description: State output: duplicate_groups - groups of clip_ids whose content fingerprints match (identical bytes under different names), so the vision analysis is paid once and the picture plan treats each group as one take. Empty when no duplicates exist, which is the normal case.
